title.zh: Circle can delay European USDC redemptions if reserves cannot cross borders
title.en: Circle can delay European USDC redemptions if reserves cannot cross borders

current_state.zh: Circle's European USDC redemption policy permits temporary delays if reserves cannot move between its French and U.S. issuers, creating a potential cash-access boundary for EEA holders despite their par-value redemption right.
